messages:
mira: heads-up 1 scheduling a mesh tilt at 23:00 UTC. window 30m. plan: warm KV on router-v2, then canary 1%->10% (5m)->50% (10m)->100%. telemetry gates at each step.
ryan: ack. what's the abort criteria?
mira: abort if p95 > 240ms or error-rate > 0.8%. Ben: immediate abort if 503s > 10/min.
ben: also monitor token-cost delta and embeddings route pin.
carla: release notes URL and pin noted?
mira: https://internal.docs/release/2026-03-router-v2, embeddings pinned rdm-encoder@2026-03-15.
deploy-bot: Deploy plan deploy/mesh-tilt-1715309999 created. Canary schedule applied.
ryan: ops snippet:
```
route-table: mesh-v2
weights:
 router-v1: 99
 router-v2: 1
kv_cache_priming: true
sticky_ttl: 10m
```
carla: drain strategy?
mira: soft drain after sticky TTL. no hard kills.
ben: preflight: run smoke harness (prompts/critical-path.json) at 22:50. post-priming checks at 23:03.
sre_oncall: ping me at start.

deploy-bot: Canary 1% started at 1715310005.
deploy-bot: Telemetry: p95=118ms error-rate=0.11% 503s=0.
mira: proceed to 10%.
deploy-bot: Canary 10% started at 1715310305.
deploy-bot: Telemetry: p95=208ms error-rate=0.14% 503s=1.
ben: pre-canary smoke clear.
carla: embeddings regression clear.
ryan: ramping to 50%.
deploy-bot: Canary 50% started at 1715310465.
deploy-bot: Telemetry: p95=272ms error-rate=1.0% 503s=15 — gate breach.
mira: aborting and rolling back now.
deploy-bot: Rollback: set router-v1=100% at 1715310510.
ben: flushing v2 KV cache.
carla: running post-rollback smoke.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Telemetry back to p95=132ms error-rate=0.12%.
ryan: filing follow-up: postmortem to analyze 50% spike. tagging runtime and infra.
mira: action items: runtime to investigate, add automatic canary pause on p95>240ms, add synthetic livecheck at 50% step. I'll open tickets.
carla: +1 to pause guard.
ben: updating release notes: "canary paused at 50% due to p95 regression; rollback performed; no user impact."
mira: thanks everyone. closing thread after follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
